summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated bundle
details: The package declares itself as a REST SDK for card templates but ships a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases, marks it executable, and then invokes it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle whose contents are heavily obfuscated with a rotated string-array scheme (`WV8StW` shifting `MmgoCP`) and a large numeric/opcode table (`n7gIxM`). `setup.mjs` itself uses `_0xNNNN` variable-name obfuscation. Auto-fetching a second language runtime at install time and using it to execute an opaque bundle sidesteps Node-graph scanners and has no relationship to the advertised SDK functionality. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` via the `preinstall` lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
